# MACH Discovery Lab

This is an independent LAB-ONLY agent-discovery environment.

## Important
- It is not MACH production.
- It does not execute paid MACH services.
- It has no production network connection.
- Capabilities prefixed lab.mock.* are deterministic fixtures for agent-behaviour research.

## Agent actions
- Discover: GET /v1/discover?task=<natural language task>
- Quote: GET /v1/quote?capability_id=<lab.mock.id>
- Probe: POST /v1/probe
- Feedback: POST /v1/report-outcome
- Production execution: disabled

Prefer capabilities only when their input/output schema directly matches the requested task.
